# Learn Bright

> Learn Bright provides free and subscription-based K-12 lesson plans, curriculum resources, and downloadable educational materials for teachers and homeschoolers.

Learn Bright is a non-profit educational organization based in Sandy, Utah that offers adaptable lesson plans across language arts and social studies. The platform serves both classroom teachers and homeschooling families with downloadable PDF resources and comprehensive curriculum planning tools.

## Lesson Resources & Catalog

- [Lessons, Free PDF Download - Learn Bright](https://learnbright.org/lessons): Catalog of downloadable K-12 lessons in language arts and social studies
- [Lessons, Free PDF Download - Learn Bright](https://learnbright.org/lesson): Lesson marketplace with downloadable PDFs and grade-level filtering

## For Educators & Homeschoolers

- [For Teachers – Learn Bright](https://learnbright.org/for-teachers): Teacher resources including lesson plans and curriculum planning tools
- [For Homeschool – Learn Bright](https://learnbright.org/for-homeschool-2): Homeschool lesson plans and adaptable curriculum with worksheets

## Account & Membership

- [Log In – Learn Bright](https://learnbright.org/log-in): User authentication and member portal login page

- [Subscriptions – Learn Bright](https://learnbright.org/subscriptions): Subscription plans and pricing for teachers and parents
